newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water Power files direct access pilot.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water Power files direct access pilot.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co (WWP) said Monday it filed with state regulators an experimental direct access pilot for its residential and small commercial customers.

Under the proposal, filed with Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) and Idaho Public Utilities Commission (IPUC), about one percent of WWP's customers in those classes would be able to choose their electricity supplier.
If approved, the pilot program would run for two years beginning July 1.
A total of 2,500 residential and 300 commercial electric customers split between Washington and Idaho would be eligible to participate in the pilot.
WWP already has a direct access pilot program available for large industrial customers.
